initialization: One PCG64 generator per seed and distribution; standard Cauchy, N(0,1), U(-1,1); same x0 across alpha and dtype, cast only at simulation entry.

gates.convergence: For float64, pooled median errors at T=100000 must be no greater than at T=10000 for both MAD and Lyapunov. Intermediate lengths and all groups are reported without demanding monotonicity.
gates.precision: Apply the same accuracy gates separately per dtype, alpha, initialization. Any float32 reversal or numerical failure requires a causal audit before advancing.
gates.finite: All 150 conditions must finish with finite, nonzero observations; failed conditions remain in metrics and cannot be dropped.
gates.periodicity: Exact repeats imply a finite precision periodic orbit; save first repeat and period, distinguish from mathematical chaos.

theory: F_alpha(x)=alpha*(x-1/x), 0<alpha<1; gamma=sqrt(alpha/(1-alpha)); lambda=2*log(sqrt(alpha)+sqrt(1-alpha)). Cauchy has no population mean or variance; MAD is unscaled median absolute deviation.
scope: Uncoupled single-node consistency only; no training, synchronization, compression, decoder or superiority claims. No clipping, jitter, reseeding, or failed-orbit replacement.
independence: Seeds are replication units. Alpha, initialization and precision are controlled paired conditions, not independent samples. No iid KS p-values for time series.
